quests.question: The signal kept dropping, returning, then dropping again; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A signal that keeps dropping and returning comes and goes, which is intermittent.

quests.question: The cook washed her hands, wore gloves and cleaned every surface; her kitchen was _____.
quests.explanation: Washing hands, gloves and cleaning every surface keep food safe, so hygienic fits.

quests.question: Neon pink walls, a yellow carpet and a green sofa made the room _____.
quests.explanation: Neon pink, yellow and green clash and glare, which is garish; tasteful and subdued contradict.

quests.question: Bags packed, tickets printed and alarm set, they were _____ to leave.
quests.explanation: Packed bags, printed tickets and a set alarm show everything is done, so ready fits.

quests.question: He revised the draft daily for a year without skipping a day, working with _____ care.
quests.explanation: Daily revision for a whole year without a break shows diligent, persistent effort: sedulous.

quests.question: When everyone yelled 'Happy birthday!' from behind the sofa, Mia's mouth dropped open, totally _____.
quests.explanation: A sudden shout and a dropped jaw show she hadn't expected it, so surprised fits.

quests.question: He was asked about sales but spoke of his holiday, so his remarks were only _____ to the question.
quests.explanation: Talking about a holiday when asked about sales touches the topic only slightly: tangential.

quests.question: Every morning, rain or shine, she took the same walk; she did it _____.
quests.explanation: Doing the same walk every morning, rain or shine, is a fixed routine, so habitually fits.

quests.question: Tell her anything and she agreed; her will was so _____ that anyone could shape her views.
quests.explanation: Agreeing with anything and letting others shape her views show a yielding will: pliant.

quests.question: No signal, no landmarks, and every street looked the same; the tourists were _____.
quests.explanation: No signal, no landmarks and identical streets leave people unsure where they are: lost.

quests.question: A bed, one chair and bare walls; the room was _____.
quests.explanation: A bed, one chair and bare walls show strict simplicity with no comforts: spartan.

quests.question: The map omitted a bridge, so any route based on it was _____.
quests.explanation: A missing bridge makes every route built on the map unreliable, which is flawed.

quests.question: He didn't slip; he stuck out his foot to trip her, acting _____.
quests.explanation: 'He didn't slip' and stuck out his foot show it was on purpose, so deliberately fits.

quests.question: Her parents never let her cross the street alone, so she had a very _____ childhood.
quests.explanation: Never being allowed to cross the street alone means being protected from the world: sheltered.

quests.question: Faced with a tricky question, she turned it aside with one smooth, clever answer; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Handling a tricky question with a smooth, clever answer shows skilful quickness: adroit.

quests.question: The new tool linked to our email and calendar and everything worked together _____.
quests.explanation: Linking email and calendar so that everything works together means no visible joins: seamlessly.

quests.question: Exposed wires, a wet floor and no warning signs made the site _____.
quests.explanation: Exposed wires, a wet floor and no warnings are all dangers, so hazardous fits; safe contradicts.

quests.question: The night before the trip, Ben packed twice and couldn't sleep; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Packing twice and being unable to sleep before a trip show eager anticipation: excited.

quests.question: The map showed three exits but the signs showed five; the driver felt _____.
quests.explanation: A map and signs that disagree leave a driver unsure what to do, so confused fits.

quests.question: Within minutes the fire spread from the kitchen to the hall, growing _____.
quests.explanation: Spreading from kitchen to hall within minutes shows speed, so rapidly fits; slowly contradicts.

quests.question: Reading the unbelievable headline, Hal froze with his coffee halfway to his mouth, utterly _____.
quests.explanation: Freezing mid-sip over an unbelievable headline shows a sudden jolt, so shocked fits.

quests.question: The test came back late and the doctor frowned, so Dad paced the hall looking _____.
quests.explanation: A late result, a frowning doctor and pacing all signal concern, so worried fits.

quests.question: He sits at a desk for ten hours, then on the sofa; his lifestyle is _____.
quests.explanation: Sitting at a desk all day and then on a sofa means very little movement: sedentary.

quests.question: The coffee and the neighbours' music kept him wide _____ all night.
quests.explanation: The clues are coffee and loud music: both prevent sleep, which is why he stayed wide awake all night.

quests.question: He squandered his inheritance in a year on parties and cars; he was a _____ spender.
quests.explanation: Squandering a whole inheritance on parties and cars is wasteful spending, which is prodigal.

quests.question: Through traffic jams, rain and rude calls, her temper stayed even; she is _____.
quests.explanation: A temper that stays even through jams, rain and rude calls is steady, which is equable.

quests.question: The car swerved, braked suddenly and sped up for no reason, driving _____.
quests.explanation: Swerving, sudden braking and speeding up without reason show unpredictable movement: erratically.

quests.question: The meal had lentils, greens and whole grains, so it was _____.
quests.explanation: Lentils, greens and whole grains are packed with goodness, so the meal was nutritious.

quests.question: She cried quietly after her friend cancelled the party for the third time; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Crying quietly after a third cancellation shows hurt feelings, so upset fits; thrilled contradicts it.

quests.question: Her boss read the report, nodded and said 'excellent work'; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Praise from the boss for her report would make anyone happy, so pleased fits; annoyed contradicts.
